name: replication protein A1

function.text: RPA1 encodes replication protein A 70 kDa DNA-binding subunit [Cleaved into: Replication protein A 70 kDa DNA-binding subunit, N-terminally processed]. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin-protein adaptor activity and damaged DNA binding. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, telomere-related, 6 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
